title: Add extended workforce availability attendance and payroll schema
goal: Create secure canonical schema for availability, time off, credentials, conflict evidence, attendance, actual time, rates, payroll, and exports.

in: Rate references, periods, adjustments, immutable export batches
out: Exposing credential documents or finance data broadly

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Planned work, status, attendance evidence, actual time, approval, and payroll records remain distinct
Credential documents and finance fields have independent protected access
Tenant, assignment, currency, and reconciliation constraints are enforced
Migrations are additive, idempotent, and validated under CP-051
